figures.finding: A Tanzanian director, like an actor, writer or producer, must hold the Film Board's practitioner accreditation and ID (TZS 30,000 for three years).

sources.title: Bodi ya Filamu Tanzania (Tanzania Film Board): Vitambulisho (practitioner accreditation and IDs)
